heading: Projects
subheading: Selected work across enterprise, e-commerce, recruitment, and healthcare applications

projects.name: Mukizh – Apparel Inventory & Billing Web Application
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise apparel inventory and billing application for managing products, stock, sales, billing, and day-to-day business operations.
projects.description: Mukizh is an apparel-focused inventory and billing web application developed to streamline business operations. The platform manages product information, inventory and stock tracking, billing, sales, and related business workflows through a centralized application.
responsibilities: Developed full-stack inventory and billing workflows covering product management, stock tracking, sales, billing, and related business operations.
Built responsive and reusable interfaces for inventory, product, billing, and sales modules with a focus on usability and maintainability.
Developed and integrated backend APIs and GraphQL services to support inventory, product, billing, and transaction workflows.
Implemented business rules, validation, authentication, and role-based access to support secure and reliable application operations.
Resolved application issues and contributed to UAT and production releases throughout the project lifecycle.
achievements: Reduced manual billing effort by approximately 25% through streamlined billing workflows.

projects.name: Mukizh Fashion E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack apparel e-commerce platform with customer shopping and admin management for products, variants, customers, orders, payments, and transactions.
projects.description: Mukizh Fashion is a full-stack apparel e-commerce platform supporting both customer-facing shopping workflows and administrative operations. The platform enables customers to browse products, manage carts, place orders, and complete payments, while the admin system manages products, variants, inventory, customers, orders, payments, and transaction information.
responsibilities: Developed customer-facing e-commerce workflows covering product browsing, product details, cart management, checkout, orders, and customer interactions.
Built admin management workflows for product creation, editing, deletion, product variants, stock management, customers, orders, payments, and transaction details.
Developed backend APIs and data models supporting product catalogue, variants, inventory, customers, cart, orders, payments, and transaction workflows.
Integrated payment processing and supporting services for secure transactions, customer notifications, OTP verification, and product media management.
Implemented business validations, authentication, authorization, and workflow rules to maintain secure and consistent operations across customer and admin modules.
achievements: Improved operational efficiency by approximately 25% through streamlined customer engagement, inventory, sales, profit tracking, and secure payment workflows.

projects.name: EliteHire360 – Recruitment Management System
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise recruitment management system supporting job, candidate, recruiter, and application workflows throughout the hiring lifecycle.
projects.description: EliteHire360 is an enterprise recruitment management system designed to manage the hiring lifecycle from job creation and candidate sourcing to application tracking and recruitment workflows. The platform provides secure, role-based access for different users involved in the recruitment process.
responsibilities: Developed full-stack recruitment workflows covering job management, candidate management, applications, recruiter activities, and hiring processes.
Built reusable and modular frontend components for candidate and recruiter portals within a scalable application architecture.
Developed backend services and APIs for candidate, job, and application management with structured business workflows.
Implemented authentication, role-based access, validation, and workflow controls to support secure access across different user roles.
Integrated distributed backend services and contributed to debugging, performance improvements, and application enhancements.
projects.architecture: Micro Frontend and Monorepo architecture with distributed backend services.
achievements: Reduced manual candidate sourcing and shortlisting effort by approximately 15% through integrated recruitment workflows.

projects.name: Fraud Identification Executive (FRIDEX)
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise healthcare fraud identification and claim review application supporting secure data analysis and audit workflows.
projects.description: FRIDEX (Fraud Identification Executive) is an enterprise healthcare fraud identification and claim review application. It supports users in reviewing beneficiary and healthcare claim information, identifying potential fraud indicators, and managing audit workflows through secure, role-based interfaces.
responsibilities: Developed responsive frontend interfaces for healthcare claim review, fraud identification, and audit workflows.
Built reusable UI components and frontend modules for different user roles and business workflows.
Integrated frontend screens with backend REST APIs to retrieve and display application data.
Implemented form validation, data handling, filtering, and user interactions across application modules.
Resolved frontend issues and contributed to UI enhancements, debugging, and usability improvements.
